The 2010 Lincoln Town Car is a classic executive full-size, rear-wheel-drive sedan (F-segment sedan) from the third generation (FN145/FN146) in its final facelifted form. It was one of the last classic "Americans" built on the robust Ford Panther body-on-frame platform and equipped with a traditional V8 engine. The vehicle symbolized conservative American luxury, featuring monumental styling, an incredibly smooth ride, and a spacious, often six-seat, cabin focused on passenger comfort.
